abstract_evidence_excerpt: In this study, barley straw and hay co-substrate was pretreated with a microaerobic barley straw-adapted microbial (BSAM) consortium prior to anaerobic digestion. BSAM pretreatment resulted in 15.2 L kg-1 TS of methane yield after 35 days, almost 40 times more than the control.
